display_name: Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ): Number of missing Quality of Life items
description:
Subscore for the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ) self-efficacy domain. The subscore quantifies patients' perceptions of how to prevent heart failure exacerbations and manage complications when they arise. This scale is not included in the summary scores. The subscore is based on a 5-point ordinal scale of 2 items and standardized to range from 0 to 100 with higher scores indicating more confident in the ability to manage the heart failure condition. [Green CP 2000 (PubMed ID: 10758967)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10758967/)
